thread:
zoe: Heads-up: noticed console per-route quota tiles will lose attribution once the upcoming TS SDK change replaces `x-route-hint` with `x-rd-route-tag`. We should plan a short migration to avoid "unknown" buckets.

michael: Thanks. Do we know which SDKs are changing and timeline?

zoe: TS minor next week, Go shortly after, Py maybe later. Idea: console server-side aliasing + SDK dual-emit behind a feature flag for ~2 releases.

priya: Console aliasing seems quickest. We'll map incoming `x-rd-route-tag` -> existing route dimension. Also add a deprecation banner in the route settings with a cutover date.

michael: For quotas, ledger keys must not change. Mapping should only affect labels shown in UI; the ledger key used for billing/commitments must remain the canonical route fingerprint.

zoe: Agreed. SDKs will keep the canonical value identical; hash algorithm unchanged. We'll implement dual-header emission like: 
```ts
headers['x-rd-route-tag'] = value
headers['x-route-hint'] = headers['x-route-hint'] || value
```
This will be behind a flag default-on for two releases.

priya: Telemetry: console should emit `route_header_mapped` (true/false) per sampled request, and a counter of mapped token volume per route value so product can monitor adoption. Also emit an alert if mapped fraction > 50% after the cutover window.

michael: Add an event `route_header_conflict` when both headers are present but values differ. That will catch proxy-induced rewrites.

devops-bot: deploy-bot: starting canary for console aliasing in us-east-1 (5 hosts -> 20 hosts) over 20m. Watch: console-quota-tiles, route-mapping-errors.

zoe: Also chiefs: some customers' proxies lowercase or rewrite header names (dots/underscores). Server should canonicalize header names and match on value. Priya, confirm mapping logic uses value normalized (trim/lower) not raw header key.

priya: Yup will normalize values and strip safe chars. I'll add unit tests for `_`, `-`, and `.` variants.

michael: UX ask: banner should link to docs with curl examples showing both header names and proxy configs (nginx/envoy) to preserve headers.

zoe: Action items:
- zoe: coordinate TS/Go dual-header PRs + feature flag (ETA 48h)
- priya: implement console aliasing + banner + telemetry counters (ETA 72h)
- michael: confirm ledger immutability & add conflict telemetry to sampling pipeline (ETA 48h)
- devops-bot: run canary and report (ongoing)

priya: I'll post the mock of the quota tile showing native vs mapped token split when ready.

michael: One more: please avoid long-term duplication. Console mapping timed window should be explicit in the banner (start/cut date) and remove mapping after the window.

zoe: Good call. Target window: 60 days mapping + 30 days banner grace. We'll include this in the customer comms draft.

devops-bot: deploy-bot: canary progressed to 20 hosts, no mapping errors observed.

zoe: Thanks all. I'll file the follow-ups in the roadmap and tag SDK leads.
